items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You said something about Ma Rainey. I was wondering if /Ma Rainey had traveled on that TOBA circuit? [INTERVIEWER] I heard her, that's right. I heard her at the Eighty-One...

ctx.x: I remember when Fletcher Henderson came there. And Bessie Smith. Fletcher Henderson had about 4 pieces.
Did Ma Rainey ever show up there?
